name: Sarasota County, FL
findings: Sarasota County has 1,823 nonprofit organizations. 662 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 537 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Sarasota County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
